title: BookingPlanDue
description: A booked plan's pickup is near: time for the reminder, time to set off, or the pickup time came and the driver has not set off. One event per stage per booking.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

stage.title: PlanStage
stage.description: `reminder`: the pickup is `plan_reminder_minutes` away. `departure`: `plan_departure_minutes` away, the app opens navigation. `overdue`: the pickup time came and the haul has not set off; operators are told too.

pickup_address.description: First pickup stop's address; null only when the load has no stops.
